decision.reason: Owner approval in the workspace marks version 1.0.0 GO for external pilot based on the accepted P0-P3 evidence bundle; target-environment artifacts remain post-GO evidence hardening work.

gates.title: Define the target-environment pilot rehearsal runbook.
gates.summary: Runbook names required inputs, gates, evidence, owners, pass/fail criteria, and go/no-go template.

gates.title: Run target-environment deployment smoke.
gates.summary: Local pilot-equivalent deployment smoke passed for migrator, API, worker, health, authenticated read/write, metrics, backup/restore, pgvector, and rollback validation.

gates.title: Attach fresh pilot release evidence.
gates.summary: Payload-safe local release evidence is attached for benchmark gate, live agent-contract smoke, governance/compliance smoke, backup/restore validation, and alert artifact validation.

gates.title: Sign the external-pilot go/no-go record.
gates.summary: Version 1.0.0 GO replacement is recorded by owner approval in the workspace; residual target-environment artifacts are tracked as post-GO evidence hardening.

gates.title: Reconcile external-pilot documentation truth.
gates.summary: Docs captured the prior NO-GO truth and now point current release decisions at the v1.0.0 GO replacement.

gates.title: Extract release-readiness status contract.
gates.summary: Machine-readable readiness status and schema now centralize EPR gate names, statuses, evidence links, blockers, and next recommended work.

gates.title: Add pilot operator cockpit.
gates.summary: Admin Pilot view and readiness endpoint surface EPR gates, current GO decision, evidence links, payload-safety state, and post-GO hardening work from the structured status contract.
